item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Gulf Nations and Israel Face New Attacks After Trump Claims Military Success
item.summary: President Trump said the United States would hit Iran “extremely hard” over the next two to three weeks. He said the war was already a success but did not offer a concrete exit timeline.

item.title: Evacuated From War-Torn Gaza, 11 Toddlers Return Home to Hugs and Tears
item.summary: The Palestinian children were born prematurely in the early days of the war and moved from a besieged hospital to Egypt. They have now returned home to the enclave, which lies in ruins.

item.title: Israel’s Message to a Broad Swath of Lebanon: Shiites Must Go
item.summary: Israel has issued sweeping evacuation warnings, and pressed some Christian and Druse leaders to expel Shiite Muslims from southern towns, the leaders said.

item.title: The Sailors Stranded in the Persian Gulf
item.summary: Thousands of civilian sailors have been stranded for more than a month in waters surrounded by a conflict zone because of the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: French Prosecutors Link Foiled Attack on American Bank to a Pro-Iranian Group
item.summary: The group is suspected of involvement in a string of attacks on Jewish targets in Belgium, Britain and the Netherlands.

item.title: 5 Takeaways From Trump’s Address on Iran
item.summary: President Trump did not define a clear path out of the conflict, which he estimated would end within three weeks.

item.title: Transcript: Trump’s Speech on Iran War
item.summary: The president made his case for the U.S. attack, and said that the main objectives had been achieved.

item.title: What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Wednesday.
item.summary: Formidable strikes rocked Tehran early Wednesday morning. Iran launched what its state-aligned media called one of the largest attacks on Israel yet, damaging several cities.
